Let retained paired-band data represent original sources $f_L,f_R$ of lengths $N_L,N_R$, positive band size $g$, modulus $p$, and signed shift. Let $K$ equal the actual common padded band count. For dimensions $h,J$ and cutoff at most $464hJ$, suppose the cover input is stored, all occurrence and bank regions are ordered, and the exact digit, quotient, bank-helper, space, word, and depth bounds hold. Starting from the displayed computed controls, the remaining block constructs the occurrence table and all retained source banks, returns their exact finish address, and preserves memory below the occurrence base within its after-count time.
